description: This file defines an abstract class `ReportAPI` for handling report-related API endpoints in the OrangeHRM system. It manages retrieving report headers and filters, validates request parameters, and enforces method implementations for report fetching. It serves as a base class for specific report APIs.

classes.name: ReportAPI
classes.description: An abstract class providing REST API endpoints for report management, including retrieving headers and filters, parameter validation, and enforcing implementation for report retrieval.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific report's header and filter definitions, packaging the result as an EndpointResourceResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET one report request, based on the report name parameter.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Method intended for updating reports, but not implemented in this abstract class.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating reports; not implemented in this class.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method intended for deleting reports, but not implemented in this abstract class.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting reports; not implemented.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain the report object, must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getReportName
methods.description: Retrieves the report name parameter from the request.

methods.name: getReportNameParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for the report name parameter, ensuring it is a string.
